cohort: The study included 163 neonates born at >=36 weeks gestational age with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) who underwent therapeutic hypothermia in Florida between 2012 and 2020.
finding: Early nutritional support, including parenteral nutrition and enteral feeding, is well-tolerated in neonates undergoing therapeutic hypothermia for HIE and may enhance neurodevelopmental outcomes and promote growth.
